10 Tips for Organizing your Outlook Inbox


Tip #1:  Organize your inbox using folders
Outlook's "folder" feature allows you to group similar messages together for easy retrieval.  For example, you could create a folder for each of your projects, and move all the messages related to that project into that folder.  When you need to find information on a particular project, simply click on the appropriate folder and all the related messages will appear.

Tip #2:  Clean out your inbox regularly
In order to keep your inbox organized, it is important to clean it out periodically.  This means moving items from your inbox to appropriate folders and deleting any items that are no longer needed.  A clean inbox will not only look nicer, but it will also be much easier to manage.

Tip #3:  Use folders for each of your projects
If you are working on multiple projects, it can be helpful to use folders for each project.  This way you can keep all the messages related to a particular project together in one place.
